description: A residue guard is a fact about the guarded path: inside x % 2 == 0 the value is in one residue class of the modulus, so the nested x % 2 == 1 test is decided false and its then arm is named dead. Naming the dead arm is strictly more information than partitioning the nested test as dynamic.

facts.name: the exclusive residue test partitions as always_not_taken
